entities.summary: Lorenzo Bianchi was born in Italy, at Corteno, near Brescia. Mons. Lorenzo Bianchi was ordained a Priest of the Pontifical Institute for Foreign Missions (PIME) on 23 September 1922 and arrived in Hong Kong on 13 September 1923.
